startupCompatibility.title: Wayland needs a compatible version
startupCompatibility.futureSchema: This Wayland build supports database schema v{{supportedVersion}}, but your data was written with v{{currentVersion}}. Nothing was changed. Reopen Wayland with the newer compatible version or use a verified recovery point.
startupCompatibility.unreadable:
Wayland could not safely inspect its database, so startup was stopped before your data was changed. Check the logs or use a verified recovery point.

Reason: {{reason}}
